payload.name: Controlled salience suppression
payload.fact: Controlled salience suppression is a banner processing mode where users actively manage their attention to avoid salient stimuli.
payload.boundary: This mode is part of a process model explaining how banner processing evolves from an evolutionary perspective.

provenance.title: Solving the Distinctiveness - Blindness Debate: A Unified Model for Understanding Banner Processing
provenance.quote_or_locus: we develop a process model that shows the transitions between three banner processing modes – automatic salience capture, controlled salience suppression, and automatic salience suppression
